As stated previously, on June 3, 1942, after the Japanese attacked Pearl Harbor, Hawaii, (December 7, 1941) they attacked the U.S. a second time by air bombing of Dutch Harbor on the small island of Amaknak, Alaska. On June 7, 1942, the Japanese landed on the Aleutian Islands of Kiska and Attu. The battles in the Aleutians were the only World War II battles on U.S. soil.
